customer_name: Public Ministry of Rio Grande do Sul (MPRS)
business_problem: MPRS needed to manage rising legal caseloads, archived police inquiries, and public-service requests more efficiently, but the volume of legal documents and the need for compliant, locally controlled analysis made traditional manual and standard RAG workflows too slow and unreliable.
solution_summary: WideLabs built the Justice Intelligence platform for MPRS on NVIDIA's NeMo stack to support investigations and citizen-facing legal access. TORI Investigation Assistant uses NVIDIA NeMo Retriever for embedding, reranking, and hybrid search inside retrieval-augmented generation pipelines deployed as NVIDIA NIM microservices against legal databases. Archiving Intelligence Assistant applies natural-language analysis to police inquiries and archiving decisions, while the Citizen Access Agent uses NeMo Guardrails for secure routing, case-type determination, document management, and appointment scheduling. Under the hood, NVIDIA AI Enterprise provides the managed software foundation, NeMo Curator preprocesses tens of thousands of documents for retrieval, and NeMo Customizer plus NeMo Aligner adapt models to the local legal domain. The result is a locally controlled, compliance-oriented legal AI platform that combines RAG, guardrails, and curated data pipelines for prosecutors and the public.

data_flow: Legal records, police inquiries, and citizen requests enter the Justice Intelligence platform, NeMo Curator prepares the document base, NeMo Retriever and NIM drive RAG search and agent responses, Guardrails governs routing and safe interaction, and the results are returned to prosecutors, analysts, or citizens through investigation and access assistants.
business_outcome: The platform moved investigations that could last months or years to less than a day, improved transparency and access for more than 8 million citizens across 497 municipalities, and created a compliant AI foundation for corruption analysis, case archiving, and public legal assistance.
metrics: Over 82 million pending legal cases in Brazil
About 60,000 police inquiries archived each year in Rio Grande do Sul
Procedures and investigations resolved or advanced in less than a day
architecture_clues: Local control over data and models was a design requirement due to legal and regulatory constraints.
The platform uses enhanced RAG with hybrid search, reranking, advanced chunking, and legal-domain model customization.
MPRS runs separate agent experiences for investigators and citizens on top of the same NeMo-based foundation.
